# Library

> A catalog of 529 works in 15 collections in this repository. Each record has a permanent accession number, a link to its plate, its source file, and its technique and atom terms.

## Data

- [Catalog](catalog.json): records, technique and atom terms with the records that use them, see-also links, audit.
- [Accession register](accessions.json): record id to accession number.
- [Fixity](fixity.json): sha256 of each source file at build time.

## Collections

- [Encyclopedia](../encyclopedia/): 176 records. Techniques, atoms, explorations and couplings in one manifest. Source: `encyclopedia/manifest.js + content/<id>/entry.js`.
- [Techniques & Templates](../techniques-templates/): 61 records. Measured studies and templates. Each study has a spec. Source: `techniques-templates/_shared/entries.js + techniques/<id>/spec.json`.
- [Technique Studies](../techniques-templates/index.html#techniques): 36 records. Read plates, one reference each. Moved into Techniques & Templates on 2026-11-12; the old technique-studies/ addresses redirect. Source: `techniques-templates/studies/st-NN-*/index.html (window.STUDY inside each plate)`.
- [Printed Matter](../printed-matter-studies/): 15 records. Paper-and-ink studies on one page, each at its own anchor. Source: `printed-matter-studies/index.html (one page, one builder per study)`.
- [Single studies](../gallery/): 3 records. One-page studies that belong to no series. Source: `<folder>/index.html + tool.json`.
- [Instruments](../): 4 records. Working tools. Source: `<folder>/index.html + tool.json`.
- [MASSIVE](https://jalulia.github.io/massive/): 17 records. The MASSIVE hub: match statistics, explorations, reference motion, screensavers. Source: `github.com/jalulia/massive`.
- [Mad Money Tycoon](https://jalulia.github.io/RCT-MM/): 12 records. The game, its design document, sprite catalogue and exploration archive. Source: `github.com/jalulia/RCT-MM`.
- [Desktop Bo](https://jalulia.github.io/bo/): 15 records. The desktop pet: design document, playable builds, sprite tests. Source: `github.com/jalulia/bo`.
- [Mode Mode](https://jalulia.github.io/modemode/): 3 records. The field studio site and its About studies. Source: `github.com/jalulia/modemode`.
- [Reliquary](https://jalulia.github.io/holy-ops-v2/): 4 records. Holy Ops, the relic exchange terminal and the synth. Source: `github.com/jalulia/holy-ops-v2, relic-grid, reliquary-synth`.
- [Other sites](.): 39 records. One-page sites in their own repositories. Source: `github.com/jalulia/<repo>`.
- [Garden](.): 4 records. The garden system and its studies. Source: `Claude artifacts, local files`.
- [Loose studies](.): 128 records. Single pieces with no series: plates lifted from pages that are not online. Source: `Claude artifacts, local files`.
- [Held](.): 12 records. Work that is not on the deployed site: staged patches, proposals, and plates on the working machine. Source: `library/_build/holdings.json (hand-kept)`.

## Specs

- [TS-01 Moiré from two ring screens](../techniques-templates/techniques/ts-01-moire-ring-screens/spec.json): Two ring gratings multiplied into a moiré, printed as blue and red around one hot core.
- [TS-02 Four-ink spot illustration](../techniques-templates/techniques/ts-02-four-ink-spot-illustration/spec.json): A black keyline and three flat spot inks, slipped 1 to 2.5 u off register, with hatch and dot tints.
- [TS-03 Iridescent chrome on black](../techniques-templates/techniques/ts-03-iridescent-chrome/spec.json): A bent chrome slab shaded through a spectral lookup table, with film grain and split-channel type.
- [TS-04 Stacked card scroll](../techniques-templates/techniques/ts-04-stacked-card-scroll/spec.json): Full-height rounded cards that pin to one top offset and stack as the page scrolls.
- [TS-05 Vertical line-screen type](../techniques-templates/techniques/ts-05-line-screen-type/spec.json): Heavy type printed through a vertical line screen whose bar width follows a phase field.
- [TS-06 Riso three-plate separation](../techniques-templates/techniques/ts-06-riso-plate-separation/spec.json): One isometric drawing printed as three riso plates, each off register by a few pixels.
- [TS-07 Gradient-mapped blur type](../techniques-templates/techniques/ts-07-gradient-map-blur-type/spec.json): Type and blobs merged into one mask, blurred, then mapped through a ramp from black to light gray.
- [TS-08 Flat-color card set](../techniques-templates/techniques/ts-08-flat-color-card-set/spec.json): Six flat-color cards with condensed type at two scales and mono metadata at the edges.
- [TS-09 Grain gradient layers](../techniques-templates/techniques/ts-09-grain-gradient-layers/spec.json): Three gradient panels with one soft mask, one ripple band and one grain across all three.
- [TS-10 Thermal blob field](../techniques-templates/techniques/ts-10-thermal-blob-field/spec.json): Blurred blobs mapped through a ramp with one dark stop at the rim.
- [TS-11 Worn black box](../techniques-templates/techniques/ts-11-worn-black-box/spec.json): A black board box, front and back, worn at every edge, with stickers and a barcode.
- [TS-12 Perforated stamp](../techniques-templates/techniques/ts-12-perforated-stamp/spec.json): A red stamp with a bitten perforation and a rotated title filled with a dot screen.
- [TS-13 ASCII glyph-field animations](../techniques-templates/techniques/ts-13-glyph-field-animation/spec.json): Monospace glyphs as particles: a helix, a wave, an orbit and a pulse, all drawn with fillText.
- [T-03 Strategy deck](../techniques-templates/templates/t-03-strategy-deck/template.json): A strategy-deck template — 29 layouts on a fixed 1600 × 900 stage, one per slide with a usage note (N), generated image slots, and a machine-readable template.json.
- [TS-14 Deep Space Chroma · birefringence](../techniques-templates/techniques/ts-14-deep-space-chroma/spec.json): A stressed birefringent sheet between crossed polarizers, integrated over the visible spectrum.
- [TS-15 Banknote engraving](../techniques-templates/techniques/ts-15-banknote-engraving/spec.json): A picture reprinted as one-ink intaglio: swelling lines, crosshatch, guilloche and one kept hue.
- [TS-16 Stipple bank and dot burst](../techniques-templates/techniques/ts-16-stipple-cloud-bank/spec.json): One jittered dot lattice. Tone fields shade the banks and draw the burst.
- [TS-17 Warped ring cells](../techniques-templates/techniques/ts-17-warped-ring-cells/spec.json): Rounded cells on a sheet pulled at four points, inked by thirteen pools, printed as single pixels.
- [TS-19 Arc bundles on a dashed globe](../techniques-templates/techniques/ts-19-arc-bundle-field/spec.json): Bundles of thin arcs leave one hub as a trunk and fan apart at the far end.
- [TS-22 Capsule system](../techniques-templates/techniques/ts-22-capsule-rain/spec.json): One capsule, drawn by one function, used as a field, a helix, a dial, controls and icons.
- [PL-01 Green screen-tone blooms](../techniques-templates/plates/pl-01-green-screen-blooms/spec.json): Four blooms printed as one green ink through a dot screen. 4 figures.
- [PL-02 Records in dots](../techniques-templates/plates/pl-02-records-in-dots/spec.json): A record drawn one dot per character, read seven ways. 7 figures.
- [PL-03 Rings on black](../techniques-templates/plates/pl-03-rings-on-black/spec.json): Rings of glowing dots on black, with the waves and chords under them. 6 figures.
- [PL-04 Node rings on white](../techniques-templates/plates/pl-04-node-rings/spec.json): The same ring of nodes, from black ink to a thin blue net. 4 figures.
- [PL-05 The helix step](../techniques-templates/plates/pl-05-helix-step/spec.json): A record as a staircase that turns, with a walker on it. 6 figures.
- [PL-06 Helix forms](../techniques-templates/plates/pl-06-helix-forms/spec.json): One helix, drawn seven ways. 7 figures.
- [PL-07 Counts as bars](../techniques-templates/plates/pl-07-counts-as-bars/spec.json): Counts, states and areas drawn as plain bars. 4 figures.
- [PL-08 Resonance patterns](../techniques-templates/plates/pl-08-resonance/spec.json): Moiré, contour, tartan and plate figures from crossed periodic fields. 4 figures.
- [PL-09 Gradient cards and die-cuts](../techniques-templates/plates/pl-09-gradient-cards/spec.json): Cards cut to arches, steps and notches, each filled with a soft gradient. 4 figures.
- [PL-10 Garden, atlas, agenda, sphere](../techniques-templates/plates/pl-10-seven-ways-in/spec.json): Seven entries drawn as a garden, a map, an agenda and a sphere. 4 figures.
- [PL-11 Signal cards](../techniques-templates/plates/pl-11-signal-cards/spec.json): Cards that each carry one field and one word. 5 figures.
- [PL-12 Fields of characters](../techniques-templates/plates/pl-12-character-fields/spec.json): Letters and marks laid out as fields. 2 figures.
- [PL-13 Constructions in perspective](../techniques-templates/plates/pl-13-perspective-constructions/spec.json): A one-point stair and an isometric stack. 2 figures.
- [PL-14 River and riverbed](../techniques-templates/plates/pl-14-river/spec.json): A river and its banks drawn as tiles. 1 figure.
- [PL-15 Pico carrier schematics](../techniques-templates/plates/pl-15-pico-schematics/spec.json): Circuit and timing drawings for a microcontroller board. 6 figures.
- [PL-16 Leaders, frames and tags](../techniques-templates/plates/pl-16-leaders-frames-tags/spec.json): Rules for frames, leaders and tags, drawn as examples. 4 figures.
- [PL-17 Diagrams of a reading, I](../techniques-templates/plates/pl-17-capschiz-1/spec.json): Diagrams that draw an argument, one claim each. 7 figures.
- [PL-18 Diagrams of a reading, II](../techniques-templates/plates/pl-18-capschiz-2/spec.json): Diagrams that draw an argument, one claim each. 7 figures.
- [PL-19 Desktop Bo, states and scenes](../techniques-templates/plates/pl-19-desktop-bo/spec.json): A desktop pet: its states, its frames and its yard. 4 figures.
- [PL-20 MASSIVE fields and counts](../techniques-templates/plates/pl-20-massive-fields/spec.json): A field bent by wells, a lattice and a count per day. 4 figures.
- [PL-21 The park and its buildings](../techniques-templates/plates/pl-21-the-park/spec.json): A park and two buildings as isometric sprites. 3 figures.
- [PL-22 Cathode-ray receivers](../techniques-templates/plates/pl-22-cathode-ray/spec.json): Five televisions drawn in one gray line. 5 figures.
- [PL-23 Keyline and ink, texture and color](../techniques-templates/plates/pl-23-keyline-texture/spec.json): Flat shapes in a keyline with printed texture. 4 figures.
- [PL-24 Keyline and ink, type](../techniques-templates/plates/pl-24-keyline-type/spec.json): Condensed capitals in flat color. 4 figures.
- [PL-25 Keyline and ink, assembly](../techniques-templates/plates/pl-25-keyline-assembly/spec.json): Finished sheets: type, flowers and frames in a few inks. 6 figures.
- [PL-26 Orthographic subjects](../techniques-templates/plates/pl-26-fidelity/spec.json): Orthographic drawings of two objects and their sources. 4 figures.
- [PL-27 Bar charts in gold and black](../techniques-templates/plates/pl-27-sample-charts/spec.json): Two ranked bar charts in gold, black and gray. 2 figures.
- [PL-28 Soft focus, experiments](../techniques-templates/plates/pl-28-soft-focus-1/spec.json): Plum blossoms, lights and bokeh, from sharp to soft. 5 figures.
- [PL-29 Soft focus, type and finals](../techniques-templates/plates/pl-29-soft-focus-2/spec.json): Soft fields under crisp type and one sharp subject. 5 figures.
- [PL-30 Line and wash](../techniques-templates/plates/pl-30-material-lines/spec.json): A fern and an apricot in line, wash and dots. 2 figures.
- [PL-31 Optics, markers and plates](../techniques-templates/plates/pl-31-optics/spec.json): Rays, markers and one color plate from crystal optics. 3 figures.
- [PL-32 The garden drawn](../techniques-templates/plates/pl-32-garden/spec.json): The garden as a bed, a plan, a drawing and a sheet. 4 figures.
- [PL-33 The cave rig](../techniques-templates/plates/pl-33-cave-rig/spec.json): A projection rig in plan and elevation. 2 figures.
- [PL-34 How a moth works, I](../techniques-templates/plates/pl-34-moths-1/spec.json): A moth, its warmth and its hearing, drawn as plates. 6 figures.
- [PL-35 How a moth works, II](../techniques-templates/plates/pl-35-moths-2/spec.json): Light, color and the Io moth, drawn as plates. 5 figures.
- [PL-36 Information, drawn](../techniques-templates/plates/pl-36-shannon/spec.json): A wire diagram and three curves from information theory. 4 figures.
- [PL-37 Weighed](../techniques-templates/plates/pl-37-weighed/spec.json): A scale, an envelope and a stamp in flat color. 1 figure.
- [PL-38 Counted fields](../techniques-templates/plates/pl-38-counted-fields/spec.json): Tone set as a count of single dots, in a dark green and a teal on white. 4 figures.
- [PL-39 Counted forms](../techniques-templates/plates/pl-39-counted-forms/spec.json): A record drawn in stipple: a twisted strand, a ring of strokes, arcs and counted bars. 5 figures.
